abstract_sentences.text: The rapid progress of large, pretrained models for both visual content generation and 3D reconstruction opens up new possibilities for text-to-3D generation.

evidence.anchor: opens up new possibilities for text-to-3D generation

abstract_sentences.text: Intuitively, one could obtain a formidable 3D scene generator if one were able to combine the power of a modern latent text-to-video model as “generator” with the geometric abilities of a recent (feedforward) 3D reconstruction system as “decoder”.

evidence.anchor: combine ... text-to-video model ... with ... 3D reconstruction system

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce VIST3A, a general framework that does just that, addressing two main challenges.
First, the two components must be joined in a way that preserves the rich knowledge encoded in their weights.

evidence.anchor: preserves the rich knowledge encoded in their weights

abstract_sentences.text: We revisit model stitching, i.e., we identify the layer in the 3D decoder that best matches the latent representation produced by the text-to-video generator and stitch the two parts together.

evidence.anchor: identify the layer ... and stitch the two parts together

abstract_sentences.text: That operation requires only a small dataset and no labels.

evidence.anchor: only a small dataset and no labels

abstract_sentences.text: Second, the text-to-video generator must be aligned with the stitched 3D decoder, to ensure that the generated latents are decodable into consistent, perceptually convincing 3D scene geometry.
To that end, we adapt direct reward finetuning, a popular technique for human preference alignment.
We evaluate the proposed VIST3A approach with different video generators and 3D reconstruction models.

evidence.anchor: different video generators and 3D reconstruction models

abstract_sentences.text: All tested pairings markedly improve over prior text-to-3D models that output Gaussian splats.
Moreover, by choosing a suitable 3D base model, VIST3A also enables high-quality text-to-pointmap generation.

result_inventory.comparison: 五个 prior text-to-3DGS 方法；DPG-Bench 100 prompts。

claim_closure.claim: 复用强 3D decoder 可避免从头训练 custom decoder。
claim_closure.method_response: Eq.(1)–(2) 切掉前部并保留下游，pseudo-target ℓ1/LoRA 做自监督恢复。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 5 显示 pointmap/pose 近似保留；Table 3 显示 NVS 提升。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 p.10 回收 model stitching 与无需 labels/massive runs。

evidence.anchor: self-supervised and does not require labels
our key idea is to employ model stitching

claim_closure.claim: 生成器与 decoder 必须在 inference-time 对齐。
claim_closure.method_response: Eq.(3) 将 Lgen 与 decoder-aware reward 合并，reward 覆盖 decoded image、3D representation、consistency。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 6/ Fig.7 对比 multi-view/no-finetune/reward；full objective 的 imaging/Unified Reward 最好。

claim_closure.claim: MSE 能找 transferable stitching layer。
claim_closure.method_response: Eq.(2) 对每一层拟合 least-squares map 并选最小误差。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig.5 支持 Wan+VGGT；Fig.6 显示 CKA 更不精确；Fig.10 显示绝对 MSE 跨架构不可比。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §4.4 回收 MSE 结论，但没有跨架构统一定律。

evidence.anchor: lower stitching residual indeed yield better pointmaps
absolute MSE values cannot predict cross-architecture performance

claim_closure.method_response: video latent + pretrained 3D tail + reward alignment 构成生成路径。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Tables 1–2 和 Table 4 给出 benchmark/user evidence；范围为给定 prompt、baseline 和 Wan 主变体。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 用 high-quality、geometrically consistent outputs 回收。

claim_closure.method_response: VGGT 或 MVDUSt3R 的 pointmap tail 被接入 video VAE。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig.14 仅 qualitative；Table 5 是 image-to-3D reconstruction preservation，不是 text prompt 的独立定量 benchmark。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 提到 pointmaps/depthmaps，但没有统一 quantitative text-to-pointmap claim。

claim_closure.claim: 方法跨 video/3D backbone 具有一般性。
claim_closure.method_response: layer search 对每个 VAE–3D pair 独立初始化，支持多个 tail。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 3/5 与 Fig.10 覆盖多个组合，但 text-to-3DGS 主表主要是 Wan 两个变体，不能等同于每个组合都有同等 generation evidence。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 摘要和结论的 generality 在已测组合内成立，不能外推任意架构。

evidence.anchor: applicable across a range of video generative models
optimal stitching layers must be identified independently

claim_closure.claim: finetuning 不损害原 video generation capability。
claim_closure.method_response: generator 只更新 LoRA/指定参数，encoder frozen。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 7 Quality/Total 上升，但 Semantic Score 0.7275→0.7143；只有 Wan+AnySplat 与 VBench 证据。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Appendix E 给出正面总结，却未解释 semantic trade-off。

evidence.anchor: does not degrade video generation quality

claim_closure.claim: 可继承 prompt camera control 与长序列能力。
claim_closure.method_response: 直接复用 video backbone 的时序/文本条件生成。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Fig.9、Fig.16 为 qualitative examples，没有定量控制指标或超长序列 benchmark。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 正文回收为 additional results，结论未给出独立保证。

claim_closure.claim: model stitching 是可组合任意 foundation networks 的通用工具。
claim_closure.method_response: 本文只实现 video VAE encoder 到 feedforward 3D tail 的一种接口。
claim_closure.evidence_response: 未测试任意网络、任意任务或不同接口类型。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 结论使用 `great potential`，是未来方向而非本文闭合主张。

evidence.anchor: great potential for model stitching as a general tool

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以 layer-wise linear compatibility 把 video VAE latent 接入 pretrained feedforward 3D model tail，再以 full-trajectory direct reward finetuning 约束可解码性、3D consistency 与 prompt quality，形成 text-to-3DGS/pointmap 路径（pp.2–6, §§1–3, Eq.1–3）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 decoder/alignment 两个 gap、Fig.3 总图、Eq.1–3、三项 reward 的概念、高层实验设定、Tables 1–5、MSE/CKA 诊断和结论，足以判断 headline claim 在给定分母内是否成立（pp.2–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix B/C 承担 Conv3D/interpolation、loss weights、LoRA、Eq.5–6、Algorithm 1、sampling、训练和评测协议；D/E 承担组件/噪声消融、camera control、VBench、cross-VAE 及 qualitative；F/G 承担限制与 LLM 声明（pp.19–31）。正文可做 headline decision，但不能单独复现实验（pp.19–22）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.3 将 stitch 与 reward 画成上下两段因果流程；Eq.1–3 依次形式化接口、选层和训练目标；Table 6 以 no-finetune/multi-view/两类 reward/full 拆解机制，Fig.7/8 补负面视觉机制和 robustness（pp.4–6,23–25）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: text-to-pointmap 只有 qualitative evidence；unordered-view 约束延后到 Appendix F；seed、硬件、总成本和不确定性未报告；Table 7 的 Semantic Score 下降也未在正文解释（pp.7,21–22,26–27）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 复用 foundation model 时先测每层 linear transferability、闭式初始化 interface，再沿完整生成轨迹用下游 reward 对齐，并用 component ablation 与替代路径区分收益来源（pp.5,9–10,20–25）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则只在选定 video/3D pairings 与 benchmark 分母内有证据；绝对 MSE 不可跨 VAE 架构比较，无序多视图不受保证，text-to-pointmap 缺少统一定量 benchmark，不能外推为任意网络组合定律（pp.7,22,26–27）。
